snippet.title: Bunnimon Early Preview Teaser / Nintendo Switch 2 / PC
snippet.description:
Bunnimon is  set in the whimsical yet mysterious world of Pocket, where the spirit guardians have grown restless and many inhabitants have become Wanderers. Players are called from  your universe to restore balance by uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and navigating a richly stylized environment.

Puzzle-Solving Exploration: Players traverse the world of Pocket, solving environmental puzzles to uncover secrets and restore balance. Expect mechanics that involve interacting with the environment in creative ways.

Three Characters with unique abilities: Azure, Moro and Verdant. Our three Bunnimon must traverse the Pocket Prison, The Wisp Woods and the Insomnia City. 

Spirit Guardian Interactions: The narrative centers around calming restless spirit guardians and helping “Wanderers,” including mechanics tied to spiritual restoration or emotional resonance.

Narrative Discovery: The game leans into lore and world-building, uncovering story fragments through exploration.

Fully Voice Acted and Humble Score: Incredible talented individuals carry out the narration to help immerse you in the experience, with a lovely musical score with emotional motifs.

Harmony is calling. Will you answer?
